properties.short_description: Babe is a brand known for its canned wine products, including rosé wine, often promoted with discount offers and social media engagement.
Hinge is a dating app designed to help people find meaningful relationships and get off dating apps by showcasing personality through text, photos, and video.
More Labs is a brand that creates smart, problem-solving supplements including Morning Recovery, Liquid Focus, and Dream Well to support health and productivity.
Allbirds is a global footwear and apparel brand known for comfortable, sustainable shoes made with innovative natural materials.
Peloton is a fitness brand offering connected exercise equipment and streaming fitness classes including cycling, running, strength, yoga, and more.
Lululemon is a brand specializing in technical athletic apparel and footwear, known for activewear and yoga gear for men and women.
Revolve is a fashion brand and online retailer specializing in designer clothing, dresses, and occasion wear for women.
Athletic Propulsion Labs is a brand specializing in advanced athletic footwear and accessories, including innovative running shoes and slip-on designs.
Free People is a women's clothing brand specializing in bohemian fashion, offering trendy and vintage-inspired apparel and accessories.
Morgan Stewart Sport is a Los Angeles-based sportswear and swimwear brand designed by Morgan Stewart, offering stylish activewear for women.
DIRTY LEMON is a beverage brand known for its innovative, health-focused drinks including collagen-infused lemon beverages sold via text and retail.
JAJA Tequila is a brand of 100% Agave Azul tequila, offering varieties like Añejo aged in American Oak barrels for a rich flavor.
Shop Betches is a women's apparel brand offering chic and unique graphic tees, tank tops, sweatshirts, and accessories inspired by pop culture.
ClassPass is a fitness app that allows users to book thousands of workout classes and appointments across various studios and gyms.
Beach Riot is a swimwear and activewear brand known for bright, bold bikini sets, tank sport tops, and beach-inspired clothing collections.
Casamigos is an American ultra-premium tequila and mezcal brand known for smooth, small batch spirits made from 100% Blue Weber agaves.
Vitamin A is a California-based swimwear brand known for consciously crafted, sustainable bikinis and beachwear made from organic cotton.
Alo Yoga is a brand offering yoga leggings, clothes, and accessories designed for both studio practice and streetwear.
Carbon38 is a premier e-commerce brand offering performance fashion and activewear designed to move with you, including leggings, tops, and proprietary label collections.
Inamorata is a women's swimwear and beachwear brand owned and operated by Emily Ratajkowski, known for stylish bikinis and one-piece swimsuits.
